title: Q1: 1 more attorney held active license to practice law in Navajo County than previous quarter
text:
Joel F. England CEO and Executive Director of the State Bar of Arizona | https://lotl.arizona.edu/jun262019.htm
Joel F. England CEO and Executive Director of the State Bar of Arizona | https://lotl.arizona.edu/jun262019.htm
State Bar of Arizona.
In total, there were 42 active legal licenses in Navajo County in the first quarter of 2025, compared to 41 the quarter before.
Countywide, Holbrook registered the highest concentration of these licenses (14).
Additionally, the county did not issue any new active legal licenses in the first quarter of 2025, unchanged from the previous quarter.
As of March 2024, the average annual salary for a lawyer in Arizona is around $99,098 per year per year, which is just below the nationwide average.
Data refers to all lawyers who were actively practicing during the first quarter of 2025. It is important to note that not all lawyers disclose their address information, which may result in incomplete geographical data.
